title: 8th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/8/2024).
Preliminary debate on the State Debt Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Funadhoo MP Mohamed Mamdooh.

Report of the Foreign Relations Committee on the President's nominations for ambassador to the Republic of Türkiye and for ambassador to the Islamic Republic of Pakistan (in place of the current ambassador to Saudi Arabia).

Report of the Foreign Relations Committee on the President's request for Parliament's consent for the Maldives to sign the "Samoa Agreement" (the Partnership Agreement between the European Union and its member states and the members of the Organisation of African, Caribbean and Pacific States).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to debate the State Debt Bill and take up committee reports on two ambassador nominations and on joining the Samoa Agreement.
